heard: Shemeleth came with Pichol, said, God is with you in all Swear to me by the Lord, do not deal falsely at all Seven years I'm set apart, witness to the well you've done Beersheba, the oath was sworn, the covenant made by trust You took my well by force, I did not know who did it Now I see your anger rise I have heard nothing of it Seven nil I'm set apart
